inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 5 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
inputs.question: Are transformers, pull boxes, or other underground electric equipment labeled on both the electrical plan (Sheet 21) and the landscape plan (Sheet 31)? Can the locations be cross-referenced between sheets to determine if any proposed trees are within 5 lateral feet of this underground equipment? Are there trees shown in proximity to the marked locations of these utilities?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing progressive verification by first checking for presence and labeling of underground electric equipment across sheets and identifying trees in proximity, before any actual distance measurement. The agent question is a multi-part presence/sheet-discovery check (are features labeled? can they be cross-referenced? are trees nearby?), not yet a direct measurement of the 5-foot clearance.
